notes: Rows 4-7 of image 0084_0109: 13 + 13 + 14 + 11 = 51, as the record. Many signs are Arabic letter shapes with other values (sorted by shape here): the خ/ع-like Bk is ب (5x), the dotless ba-bowl Sb is س, the ط-like Tt is ت, the open ح Hh is ر, the λ is ل and the d-loop is ا. ص is the triangle-on-cross 3 times (the plaintext has three ص; the record's "4 times" is one too many). ح is a loop on a stem (F4) 3 times.
